decision.reason: The current rollout does not use CP2. TP8 duplicates four GQA KV heads across eight TP ranks, while installed vLLM-Ascend supports DCP2 for this exact TP8/4-KV-head ratio; however DCP adds decode collectives and TP4xDP4 has only limited 8K evidence, so a controlled gate is required.

model_structure.interpretation: TP4 assigns one KV head per rank. TP8 without DCP must replicate each KV head twice; DCP2 reuses the TP group to shard that duplicated KV cache by sequence.

observed_workload.interpretation: The 94K contract is a tail guardrail; observed responses are mostly 9K-18K. Current vLLM is also underfed during tool phases, so topology tuning must be combined with logical-agent oversubscription.

topology_candidates.expected_strength: proven 94K stability and lowest operational risk
topology_candidates.expected_weakness: KV-head replication and only two independent replicas

topology_candidates.expected_strength: same devices and replicas while removing the TP8 KV duplication
topology_candidates.expected_weakness: experimental DCP path adds decode collectives and has no local Qwen3.5 throughput result

topology_candidates.expected_strength: twice as many independent replicas and no KV-head replication
topology_candidates.expected_weakness: twice the weight memory per NPU and unverified 94K stable capacity
tightest long-context memory and highest tail/preemption risk

historical_topology_evidence.scope: one-run 8K GRPO engineering matrix, not the current 94K standalone screen
historical_topology_evidence.counterexample: At 4-to-4, TP4xDP4 was about 3.9% slower than TP8xDP2, so the historical matrix is directionally useful but inconclusive.

installed_runtime_evidence.dcp_world_size_behavior: reuses TP ranks and does not add devices
installed_runtime_evidence.gqa_constraint: (tensor_parallel_size / num_key_value_heads) must be at least and divisible by decode_context_parallel_size
installed_runtime_evidence.qwen_constraint_check: (8 / 4) = 2, therefore DCP2 satisfies the installed guide's GQA constraint
installed_runtime_evidence.pcp_reason: PCP expands world size and primarily improves long-prefill TTFT; the current objective is aggregate independent trajectory throughput with mostly 9K-18K responses and substantial tool time.

recommended_gate.phase_0: Keep model hash, task/sample identities, temperature/top-p/top-k, 94K context and 30-minute timeout frozen.
recommended_gate.phase_1: Cross over TP8xDP2xDCP1 and TP8xDCP2xDP2 between h05 and h06 on the same small representative task set.
recommended_gate.phase_2: Run TP4xDP4 on the same set after 94K load, one-max-length request and stable-capacity preflight pass.
recommended_gate.phase_3: Test TP2xDP8 only if TP4xDP4 wins and TP2 passes the same 94K capacity gate.
recommended_gate.primary_metric: completed generated tokens per wall-clock hour, followed by completed trajectories per hour
recommended_gate.business_metric: confirmed GRPO variance candidates per wall-clock hour in the continuation screen
guardrails: runtime errors and OOM remain zero
timeout rate does not worsen by more than 2 percentage points on a sufficiently sized continuation slice
no change to sampling distribution, model or scoring
candidate topology must improve throughput by at least 10% to justify operational change
recommended_gate.logical_admission_note: Whichever topology wins must also use a logical agent window above the physical vLLM sequence count, because current tool phases leave only about 64% of physical slots running.
